The 8 September 2026 minutes record that the 2026 water bill was $312.40 so far, “a little under last year’s pace,” and that Paolo did not have last year’s figure with him. The 3 November 2026 minutes give only the full 2026 water bill, $486.75.

Other water notes in the minutes:

- 11 August 2026: members want a second tap at the far end of the plots; Nell was to ask the city.
- 6 October 2026: the winter closing checklist should include the water shut-off.
- 3 November 2026: Wren was to shut the water off on the 14 November work day, and the city’s decision on the second tap was still pending.
